method: Extracted text + tables from local PMC JATS XML; located arm, protocol and Cmax evidence in the source before comparing with label fields. Curator verification text was not relied on. No model predictions were used or produced. Supplementary files were not available locally and were not consulted.

verdict_legend.pass_with_uncertainty: no failed check; one or more items not explicitly stated in the source (mostly IR labelling / salt basis)
verdict_legend.uncertain: no failed check but material ambiguity in the source affecting label use
verdict_legend.fail: at least one check contradicted by the source

arms.source_location: PMC10087697 (local src/PMC10087697.xml); Methods 'Study 1' para; Table 1 (SAD PK), 100 mg column

healthy_adults.evidence: 'single-dose ... study of ZYIL1 in healthy human subjects', aged 18-55; limitations: healthy adult males

single_unboosted_oral.evidence: 'Participants received a single oral dose of ZYIL1'; no co-administered booster found

postdose_fast_ge_4h.evidence: 'after fasting for at least 10 hours; no food was allowed until 4 hours after dosing'

ir_or_solution.evidence: 'active pharmaceutical ingredient in capsule'; no MR language, but not explicitly labelled immediate-release

parent_plasma_cmax.evidence: LC-MS/MS of ZYIL1 in plasma; metabolites quantified separately (<2% of parent)

dose_basis_parent.evidence: Source gives dose as compound name + mg with no salt/free-base/equivalence statement (grep for salt/HCl/mesylate/free base/equivalent: 0 hits); source cannot confirm parent-moiety basis. Label relies on external DB records, not the source.

statistic_units.evidence: Table 1 footnote: mean (SD); Cmax in ug/mL (= mg/L); N=6 for Cmax (footnote a)

numeric_transcription.evidence: Table 1 100 mg column Cmax value independently read; matches label after ug/mL->mg/L (1:1); statistic and N match

notes: Label drug_name alias does not appear in the source (source uses code ZYIL1 only); code-to-INN mapping not verifiable from the source.

Additionally the dose amount itself is internally inconsistent: test formulation 'Specification: 5 mg/capsule' vs repeated 'a 180 mg TQB3616 capsule'.

statistic_units.evidence: Table 2: 'Mean ± SD (N = 16)' header with 'Fasted (n = 11)'; footnotes define N=PK set, n=statistical analysis -- arithmetic mean over n=11 most likely but header/footnote are ambiguous; ng/mL

numeric_transcription.evidence: Table 2 Fasted Cmax independently read (also in Results text); matches label after ng/mL->mg/L; n=11 matches

notes: 5 of 16 subjects excluded from the fasted PK set for vomiting within 2x median Tmax; the fasted Cmax is a post-exclusion subset (possible bias).
Fasted Cmax is highly variable (SD ~62% of mean); the LS geometric mean in Table 3 (n=11) is much lower than the arithmetic mean.
Figure caption says 'Mean blood concentration' but the assay and tables are plasma; treated as a caption wording issue.
